tasks.visible_requirement:
Return value constrained to the inclusive minimum/maximum range. Return null when an argument is not a finite number or minimum is greater than maximum.

The exported API is `clamp(value, minimum, maximum)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Convert an ASCII identifier or phrase to lowercase kebab-case: split camel-case boundaries, treat non-alphanumeric runs as separators, trim separators, and return an empty string for non-string input.

The exported API is `toKebab(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Return the first occurrence of each value in original order using JavaScript SameValueZero equality. Return an empty array for non-array input.

The exported API is `uniqueStable(values)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Given inclusive integer [start,end] pairs with start <= end, return a sorted copy merging overlapping or directly adjacent ranges. Return [] for non-array input.

The exported API is `mergeRanges(ranges)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Parse one or more positive integer duration tokens separated by whitespace. Supported suffixes are ms, s, m, h and tokens may appear in any order. Return total milliseconds, or null for empty, malformed, duplicate-unit, or non-string input.

The exported API is `parseDuration(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

For an array of {group, amount} rows, return an object whose keys follow first-seen group order and whose values sum finite numeric amounts. Ignore malformed rows and rows with non-string groups.

The exported API is `groupTotals(rows)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Each node is {id,deps}. Return IDs in a valid dependency-first order, choosing the earliest original input position whenever several nodes are ready. Return null for duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, cycles, or malformed input.

The exported API is `topologicalOrder(nodes)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Schedule {id,cost,deps} tasks into dependency-ordered batches. IDs are unique non-empty strings, costs are positive safe integers not exceeding positive safe-integer capacity, and deps are unique string IDs. At each batch, scan currently ready tasks in original input order, include every task that fits the remaining capacity, and continue past ready tasks that do not fit. Tasks completed in a batch enable dependents only in the next batch. Return arrays of IDs, or null for malformed input, unknown dependencies, or cycles.

The exported API is `scheduleBatches(tasks, capacity)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Apply versioned {id,version,op,value?} events to an initial object. Higher versions win; equal or older versions are ignored. delete creates a tombstone so older later sets cannot resurrect an ID. Return active values only, in initial/insertion order. Invalid events are ignored.

The exported API is `reconcile(initial, events)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Apply idempotent atomic transfer batches without mutating inputs. Balances must be non-negative finite numbers under non-empty account IDs, and batches must be an array; otherwise return null. Ignore non-array batches. Within each batch, scan entries in order: ignore entries without a non-empty string id and globally repeated ids, while the first occurrence of every non-empty id consumes that id even if its batch is later rejected. The remaining fresh entries form a candidate batch. Accept a candidate only when it is non-empty and every entry has distinct existing string from/to accounts, a positive finite amount, and can be applied sequentially to a draft without an overdraft. If any fresh entry fails, reject and roll back the entire batch, but keep all its fresh ids consumed. Accepted batches commit atomically. Return {balances,acceptedBatches,acceptedTransfers}, where acceptedBatches contains original zero-based batch indexes and acceptedTransfers contains committed ids in order.

The exported API is `settleTransferBatches(balances, batches)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Truncate a finite number toward zero and clamp it to inclusive integer bounds. Return null for invalid bounds or non-finite input.

The exported API is `truncateClamp(value, minimum, maximum)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Trim a string, collapse whitespace, and uppercase the first ASCII letter of each word while lowercasing the remaining letters. Return an empty string for non-string input.

The exported API is `titleWords(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Split an array into copied chunks of positive integer size. The final chunk may be shorter. Return [] for non-array input and null for invalid size.

The exported API is `chunk(values, size)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Accept booleans unchanged and the case-insensitive trimmed strings true/yes/1 and false/no/0. Return null for every other value.

The exported API is `parseBoolean(value)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Convert input with String and HTML-escape &, <, >, double quote, and single quote, in that order, using standard named entities.

The exported API is `escapeHtml(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Return the numeric median of a non-empty array of finite numbers without sorting the input in place. Return null for invalid or empty input.

The exported API is `median(values)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Normalize CRLF and CR to LF, remove trailing spaces and tabs on each line, and remove exactly one final empty line. Return an empty string for non-string input.

The exported API is `normalizeLines(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Split a trimmed string on whitespace or hyphens and return the uppercase first character of at most the first two non-empty parts. Return an empty string for non-string input.

The exported API is `initials(name)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

For an array, discard non-finite entries and return each remaining number multiplied by a finite factor. Return [] for non-array input and null for a non-finite factor.

The exported API is `compactScale(values, factor)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Format a non-negative finite byte count using B, KiB, MiB, or GiB. Choose the largest unit not exceeding the value, round to at most one decimal, and omit .0. Return null for invalid input.

The exported API is `formatBytes(bytes)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Read own properties along a non-empty dot-separated path. Empty segments are invalid. Return fallback when traversal fails, and never read inherited properties.

The exported API is `deepGet(value, dottedPath, fallback)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Return sorted [start,end] numeric ranges with overlaps merged. Touching ranges whose end equals the next start are merged; separated ranges remain distinct. Return null for malformed ranges.

The exported API is `coalesceRanges(ranges)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Use one-based positive integer page and pageSize. Return {items,total,page,pageSize,pages}; out-of-range pages have empty items. Return null for invalid input.

The exported API is `paginate(items, page, pageSize)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Group array entries by their own string-valued property named by key. Preserve row order and first-seen group order. Ignore non-object rows and rows without a string group; return {} for invalid input.

The exported API is `groupBy(rows, key)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

For each case-insensitive key, replace the value in key=value tokens and JSON-style "key":"value" pairs with [REDACTED]. Values end at whitespace/comma for assignments and at the closing quote for JSON. Return input unchanged for invalid keys.

The exported API is `redactAssignments(text, keys)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Build a query string from an object using sorted keys. Omit null values, repeat array values in order, encode keys and values with encodeURIComponent, and stringify other primitives. Return an empty string for invalid input.

The exported API is `buildQuery(params)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Return a stable copy sorted by the named own property. direction is asc or desc. Numeric values compare numerically, other values by String; null/missing values always sort last. Return null for invalid input.

The exported API is `stableSortBy(items, key, direction)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Given finite numbers and strictly increasing finite upper bounds, return counts for (-Infinity,b0], (b0,b1], ... and (last,Infinity). Return null for malformed input.

The exported API is `histogram(values, upperBounds)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Match requested against available case-insensitively: first exact tag, then first same primary-language tag in available order, then fallback if it exists case-insensitively, otherwise null. Return the original available spelling.

The exported API is `resolveLocale(requested, available, fallback)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Return attempts non-negative integer delays starting at baseMs and multiplying by factor, each capped at maximumMs and rounded to the nearest integer. Return null unless inputs are finite, non-negative, factor >= 1, and attempts is a non-negative safe integer.

The exported API is `retrySchedule(baseMs, factor, maximumMs, attempts)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Each node is {id,deps}. Return dependency layers; preserve input order within each layer. Return null for duplicate IDs, unknown dependencies, cycles, or malformed input.

The exported API is `topologicalLayers(nodes)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Allocate an integer total across {weight,cap} entries. Repeatedly use largest-remainder proportional allocation among entries below their non-negative integer caps; fractional ties use lower index. Return null if invalid or total exceeds total caps.

The exported API is `apportionCapped(total, entries)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

For records {id,version,source,value}, choose one per id: higher integer version wins, then lexicographically smaller source on a version tie. Preserve first-seen id order and return chosen records. Ignore malformed records.

The exported API is `reconcileRecords(records)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Schedule {id,duration,deps} jobs on identical slots. At each time, start ready jobs in input order until slots fill; completions at that time happen before starts. Return [{id,start,end}] in start order. Return null for invalid graphs, durations, or concurrency.

The exported API is `scheduleJobs(jobs, concurrency)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Apply immutable operations {op,path,value?} to a JSON object. Paths are slash-separated own-property keys with ~1 and ~0 decoding. Support add/replace/remove; replace/remove require an existing key. Return null on any invalid operation, otherwise the new document.

The exported API is `applyOperations(document, operations)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Parse comma-separated text with LF or CRLF rows. Double-quoted fields may contain commas/newlines and escape quotes as doubled quotes. Empty input returns []; malformed unclosed quotes return null. Preserve empty fields and omit one final empty row.

The exported API is `parseCsv(text)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

From valid x.y.z numeric versions choose the greatest matching range. Supported ranges are exact x.y.z, ^x.y.z (same major and >= base), and >=x.y.z <x.y.z. Ignore invalid versions; return null for invalid range or no match.

The exported API is `selectVersion(versions, range)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Process finite timestamps in given order. Return booleans indicating acceptance. A timestamp is accepted when fewer than limit previously accepted timestamps are greater than timestamp-windowMs and <= timestamp. Inputs are nondecreasing; return null if invalid.

The exported API is `acceptWithinWindow(timestamps, limit, windowMs)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Given [name,value] pairs, lowercase and trim names, trim String(value), combine duplicate ordinary headers with comma+space, and keep set-cookie as an array. Preserve first-seen header order. Return null for malformed input.

The exported API is `normalizeHeaders(entries)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.

Render {{path}} with HTML-escaped own-property values and {{{path}}} with raw String values. Dotted paths are supported; missing values leave the original token. Triple braces must be recognized before double braces. Return an empty string for non-string templates.

The exported API is `renderTemplate(template, values)`. Do not mutate input values. Modify only `src/task.mjs`.
